question: ﻿Which of the following is an agriculture based industry?
solution:
The correct answer is __**silk textiles.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Silk textiles** is an **agriculture-based industry** as it involves the **cultivation of silk worms** to produce silk.
 
• Silk textiles industry is an important sector in India, especially in states like **Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, and West Bengal.**
 
• **India** is the **second-largest producer** of silk in the world after **China.**
 
• Silk is a** natural protein fiber** that is obtained from the **cocoons of silkworms.** 
 
• The cultivation of silkworms is known as **sericulture.**
 
• The silk textiles industry involves various processes like rearing **silkworms, harvesting cocoons, reeling silk threads, spinning, weaving, and dyeing**.
 
• Silk textiles are popular for their **lustrous appearance, softness, and durability.**
 
• They are used to make a wide range of products like** sarees, dress materials, scarves, ties, and home furnishings.**
 
• Apart from silk, India is also a major producer of other natural fibers like **cotton, jute, and wool,** which form the basis of several other industries like textiles, handicrafts, and carpets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Iron and steel **involves the** extraction and processing** of minerals.
 
• **Cement** involves the manufacturing of **construction material **from raw materials like** limestone and clay.**
 
• **Petrochemical ****involves** the processing of **crude oil and natural gas** to produce chemicals and plastics.
